newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market is closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival. The market reopens on April 21.
On Thursday, Malaysian rubber prices extended midday losses at the close, with traders saying there was no positive news to move the market the other way.
"It was a quiet day through and through...no inquiries or buying," said a trader.
The Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS1 buyer at 287.50 cents ($1.14) a kg, down two cents from Wednesday. May SMR20 buyer was 1.50 cents lower at 270.50.
